## Detecting Gender-Based Hate Speech on Reddit

I used R, text analysis, and supervised machine learning to classify hate speech in Reddit posts and examine patterns in the detected content.

## Predicting Loneliness from Survey Data

I used PCA, clustering, and machine-learning models to explore survey patterns and evaluate how effectively loneliness could be identified.

[View project](projects/survey-machine-learning.qmd)

## Climate Migration Discourse on Twitter

I analysed 5,482 climate-migration tweets using text cleaning, sentiment analysis, emotion analysis, and topic modelling to uncover the dominant themes shaping the discussion.

[View project](projects/climate-text-analysis.qmd)

:::

::: {.project-card}

## Web Scraping ICT Job Vacancies from Jobat

I helped build a reusable web scraper in R, cleaned the collected vacancy data, and analysed patterns in job locations, contract types, salaries, and categories.

[View project](projects/ict-job-web-scraping.qmd)
